items.title: Clashes erupt in Barcelona after thousands join Spain general strike
items.summary: Tens of thousands of people have been taking part in the strike, called by the country's main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

items.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate race in surprise victory for party
items.summary: Colom's victory makes him the first black person from Mississippi to be elected to the US Senate in more than 140 years.

items.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
items.summary: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

items.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
items.summary: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public.

items.title: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
items.summary: The news comes at a turbulent time for Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.

items.title: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
items.summary: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a former member of the Marxist guerrilla group the Red Brigades, was about to be extradited to his home country of Italy.
